cards.caption_en: A map in my hands, a quiet street, and a new way through town.
cards.caption_zh: 手里一张地图，眼前一条安静的街，我在小镇寻找新的路线。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: English scene-card base photograph, portrait 4:5. Refined Korean cool Instagram travel-fashion editorial with authentic environmental detail. Main subject is a stylish adult East Asian woman around 25, dark loose low bun, understated ivory/slate outfit, subtle magazine retouch while retaining pores, real hair and natural hands. Cool soft daylight, pearl white, fog grey, slate blue; true skin color. Clear teaching objects, coherent anatomy and perspective, deliberate breathing room near edges for later bubbles. No text, letters, digits, words, captions, brand, watermark, UI or learning labels. One polished environmental travel photograph of a small town street junction. Woman in left foreground holding an unfolded paper map with simple street lines and a blue route, absolutely no writing. A second adult local woman at right points toward the left branch, natural hands and clear faces. Main paved road leads into small-town low-rise buildings in distance; two distinct side streets branch left and right at the junction, sidewalks and kerbs make them visually legible. Both map and road junction unobstructed. Soft pale sky and calm side walls for annotation. No traffic signs with writing.

words.example: The street beside us is quiet.
words.translation: 我们身旁的街道很安静。
words.evidence: 人物身旁有建筑与人行道的街道区域。

words.example: The road leads into town.
words.evidence: 通向远处街区的主道路。

words.example: We explore a small town.
words.evidence: 远处低层街区定位故事中的小镇，不把单栋楼等同于全镇。

words.example: I check the map in my hands.
words.evidence: 手中展开的纸质路线图，无需读取地名。

words.example: Turn left at the corner.
words.evidence: 路口左侧分支与指路手势，方向以当前画面行进视角解释。

words.example: You can turn right at this corner.
words.translation: 你可以在这个拐角处向右转。
words.evidence: 路口右侧分支，句子以画面行进方向解释。

words.example: The map helps us find the way.
words.translation: 地图帮助我们找到路线。
words.evidence: 纸质地图的道路网络定位路线指代；路线含义来自例句，不把蓝色河流当成指定路线。

words.example: Where is the town centre?
words.evidence: 问路疑问句提供语境，没有独立可定位对象。

cards.caption_en: A bridge, two travellers, and a little distance between us.
cards.caption_zh: 一座桥，两位旅人，彼此之间隔着一小段距离。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: English scene-card base photograph, portrait 4:5. No text, letters, digits, words, captions, brand, watermark, UI or learning labels. One single travel editorial photograph, not a collage. Elegant pedestrian bridge crossing a river, viewed obliquely from the near bank with railings and stone walkway receding toward the far bank. Main woman mid-stride in the left foreground, full body and feet visible, clearly walking along bridge. A small silver metal whistle hangs from a dark wrist cord, large enough to identify, held lightly in her lowered hand and not near mouth. A second adult traveller farther along the bridge provides near/far contrast. River and distant bank clear with enough focus for distance, pale open sky and water edges reserved for labels. Whistle visibly has rounded mouthpiece and side opening, not jewellery.

words.example: The bridge crosses the river.
words.evidence: 桥面与护栏的实际区域。

words.example: We walk across the bridge.
words.evidence: 人物和桥面跨河路线共同定位across，句子说明跨越。

words.example: The near part of the bridge is beside me.
words.translation: 桥的近处部分就在我身旁。
words.evidence: 左前景桥栏的近处部分，相对远处桥端解释，不虚构看不见的近岸。

words.example: The other traveller is far away.
words.evidence: 桥上远处旅人的实际区域，相对前景主人公展示远近，不虚构未显示的桥端。

words.example: There is some distance between the two travellers.
words.translation: 两位旅人之间有一段距离。
words.evidence: 前后两位旅人之间延伸的桥面间隔，区域定位空间间隔，不测数值或推断距离在变化。

words.example: We walk from here to the other bank.
words.translation: 我们从这里走到另一岸。
words.evidence: 起点介词在完整句中解释，不独立框桥端。

words.example: We walk to the other bank.
words.evidence: 终点介词在完整句中解释，不等同于某物体。

words.example: I walk across the bridge.
words.evidence: 主人公完整步态和桥面接触位置。

words.example: I carry a small whistle.
words.evidence: 手中/腕绳上的实体金属哨子，选名词义而非声音。

cards.caption_en: Ticket in hand, I wait at the station for the next journey.
cards.caption_zh: 车票拿在手里，我在车站等候下一段旅程。

words.example: We wait at the station.
words.evidence: 站台、顶棚与立柱的车站区域。

words.example: The train stands beside the platform.
words.evidence: 沿站台停靠的整列车局部。

words.example: I hold my train ticket.
words.evidence: 主人公手中的独立纸票，身份由旅行故事说明。

words.example: A steel rail runs beside the platform.
words.translation: 一根钢轨沿着站台延伸。
words.evidence: 站台旁露出的单根钢轨区域。

words.example: The carriage door is open.
words.evidence: 列车开门处所在的单节车厢区域。

words.example: The porter carries my case.
words.evidence: 实际提行李的故事角色，只定位人物，不凭制服鉴定职业。

words.example: Waiting for the train gives me time to rest.
words.translation: 等火车让我有时间休息。
words.evidence: 静态照片不能证明等待持续，完整原创句支持名词义。

words.example: Our train journey begins here.
words.translation: 我们的火车旅程从这里开始。
words.evidence: 整段旅行概念由句子说明，不用列车框替代旅程。

words.example: There is an empty seat on the bench.
words.evidence: 站台长椅的空座面。

cards.caption_en: A steady hand on the wheel, a slow start, and time to stop.
cards.caption_zh: 稳稳握住方向盘，缓慢起步，留出停车的时间。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: English scene-card base photograph, portrait 4:5. Refined Korean cool Instagram travel-fashion editorial with authentic environmental detail. Main subject is a stylish adult East Asian woman around 25, dark loose low bun, understated ivory/slate outfit, subtle magazine retouch while retaining pores, real hair and natural hands. Cool soft daylight, pearl white, fog grey, slate blue; true skin color. Clear teaching objects, coherent anatomy and perspective, deliberate breathing room near edges for later bubbles. No text, letters, digits, words, captions, brand, watermark, UI or learning labels. Photographic editorial triptych within one portrait frame, clean subtle divisions and no drawn schematic: upper two-thirds a natural side passenger view of the woman driver in a real parked compact car, seat belt correctly across chest, both hands naturally on steering wheel, eyes forward, cool daylight. Lower left inset is a realistic open engine bay showing engine cover and mechanical components, no text or labels. Lower right inset is a realistic driver footwell with one clearly visible rectangular brake pedal next to a narrow accelerator; flat shoe foot poised on brake, no extra limbs. Matching cool tones and documentary detail, steering wheel, engine and brake readable for vocabulary. The car is stationary during this posed lesson; speed and timing belong to later sentences. Simple blank interior upper corners for labels; no digital display, lettering, digits or logos.

words.example: Careful driving begins with good control.
words.translation: 谨慎驾驶从良好的操控开始。
words.evidence: 握方向盘的驾驶姿势，照片为静止教学演示，不宣称行驶速度。

words.example: The engine is under the front cover.
words.translation: 发动机在前方的盖子下面。
words.evidence: 左下小幅真实发动机舱。

words.example: I hold the steering wheel with both hands.
words.evidence: 主幅中的实际方向盘，不把车轮和方向盘混用。

words.example: My foot rests on the brake pedal.
words.translation: 我的脚放在刹车踏板上。
words.evidence: 右下脚部小幅中的宽刹车踏板。

words.example: I keep control with both hands on the wheel.
words.translation: 我用双手握住方向盘来保持操控。
words.evidence: 双手与方向盘的操控动作指代区，不声称已证明驾驶能力。

words.example: I press the brake to stop the car.
words.evidence: 停车结果需时间信息，静态教学图只给动作线索，由句子说明。

words.example: A slow start feels smooth.
words.evidence: 照片不测速度，起步速度由句子说明。

words.example: I make a quick check before driving.
words.translation: 我在驾驶前迅速检查一下。
words.evidence: 检查耗时无法由静态图验证。

words.example: A small seat adjustment helps me reach the pedals.
words.translation: 稍微调整座椅能让我够到踏板。
words.evidence: 座椅调整为教学情境，不虚构图中已发生调节。

cards.caption_en: Out through the entrance, under the canopy, then up in the lift.
cards.caption_zh: 穿过入口来到外面，走到雨棚下，再乘电梯上楼。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: English scene-card base photograph, portrait 4:5. Refined Korean cool Instagram travel-fashion editorial with authentic environmental detail. Main subject is a stylish adult East Asian woman around 25, dark loose low bun, understated ivory/slate outfit, subtle magazine retouch while retaining pores, real hair and natural hands. Cool soft daylight, pearl white, fog grey, slate blue; true skin color. Clear teaching objects, coherent anatomy and perspective, deliberate breathing room near edges for later bubbles. No text, letters, digits, words, captions, brand, watermark, UI or learning labels. Two clean photographic panels stacked within one portrait frame, same adult woman and coherent cool modern building, no drawn arrows or infographic. Upper half: environmental view of pearl-grey building entrance with broad horizontal canopy overhead, woman full body taking a natural step out through an open glass door underneath canopy. Building facade, canopy, woman and door unobstructed; sky and side wall negative space. Lower half: woman standing inside a glass lift in the same building, side three-quarter view, realistic slim metal control panel at right with two separate real physical arrow-shaped up and down pushbuttons (chevron symbols only, NO letters or digits), cabin subtly lit. words.example: The building has a glass entrance.
words.translation: 这栋建筑有一个玻璃入口。
words.evidence: 上幅建筑立面与玻璃入口。

words.example: I take the lift to the next floor.
words.evidence: 下幅玻璃电梯厢与门框，不是扶梯。

words.example: The arrow points up.
words.evidence: 电梯面板上方按钮实际向上箭头，方向清楚，不宣称电梯正在上行。

words.example: The arrow points down.
words.evidence: 电梯面板下方按钮实际向下箭头，方向清楚，不宣称电梯正在下行。

words.example: I step out through the entrance.
words.evidence: 上幅跨越门槛的主人公与门口，句子给出外出方向。

words.example: I turn off the light before leaving home.
words.evidence: 独立原创离家例句，不将电梯照片当成关灯证据。

words.example: The light is on inside the lift.
words.evidence: 光亮本身不足以验证开关状态，状态由故事句子明确。

words.example: I go outside through the door.
words.evidence: 上幅人物跨门槛的步行动作，句子说明动作方向。

words.example: I stand under the canopy.
words.evidence: 上幅雨棚与其下人物的实际上下空间关系。

words.example: The canopy is over the entrance.
words.evidence: 上幅雨棚与入口共同构成上方关系。

lexical_review.method: Codex按本卡语境独立编辑复核，不声称已访问词典全文。
